results.description:
You've checked the boxes. The day still didn't happen.

Routinery tracks your routines and then runs them with you.

App of the Day 2026 (Apple) - Best ADHD App of 2025 (Forbes Health) - 5 million downloads

A habit tracker, routine tracker and day planner in one. Stack small habits into a daily routine, break it into 1-5 minute steps, and each step runs on its own timer while a voice calls out what comes next.

Morning routines, bedtime wind-downs, study blocks, workouts, medication - anything with a fixed order runs the same way.

WHY IT WORKS
- Starting gets easier. "Study" is too big to begin; "sit at the desk, 1 min" is not. Small steps lower the cost of the first move.
- Nothing to decide mid-run. You set the order once, when you built the routine. Nothing left to choose means less to stall on.
- Wins come back often. A finish is logged every step, not once a day.
- No time math. You set each step's length once. Sink into one thing and the voice pulls you out, so an afternoon doesn't vanish.

ASK CHATGPT OR CLAUDE TO BUILD IT
- "Make me a 40-minute weekday morning routine" and it lands in the app.
- Your assistant can handle routines alongside other tools you've connected there, like Google Calendar.
- Connects to ChatGPT, Claude and others over our MCP server, included in the free plan.

IT STARTS ON TIME, SCREEN OR NOT
- Set the weekdays and time; the reminder arrives then. Weekdays only, three times a week, whatever your schedule.
- The voice reads each step aloud, so the routine keeps running while you shower or cook.
- A home screen widget shows today's list without opening the app.
- Start on the phone, carry on from watch, tablet, or Mac.

STAY DEEP IN ONE THING
- A pomodoro that announces the next task, so the block keeps its own momentum.
- Build the environment: white noise, Focus mode, landscape view, Shortcuts.
- Stretch a timer, skip a step, reorder what's left - all without leaving the run.

DON'T DO IT ALONE
- Share a routine's task list with family or a friend and see how far each of you got.
- Finish a routine and the result goes straight to the person you picked.

SEE IT ADD UP
- A plant grows for each day you keep a streak; weekly and monthly stats show what holds.

FOR THE DAILY AND THE ONE-OFF
- Keep undated tasks and weekly repeats in one daily routine planner.
- A one-time task gets a timer too.
- Can't face it now? Park it in Anytime for later.
- Shift work that moves weekly still fits: Morning, Afternoon, Evening.
- See the day as a list, a calendar, or a timeline.

WHO USES ROUTINERY
- Adults with ADHD who know the task and still can't start
- People who lose hours once they sink into something
- People who double-check in case they missed one
- Anyone who waits to start until they can do it perfectly
- Shift workers, people on daily medication, parents on the school run
- Anyone who wrote a routine down and never once ran it

ROUTINERY AT A GLANCE

Is Routinery free?
Yes. 2 routines free, no account, first one running in under a minute. Premium lifts the routine cap: monthly, 6-month or yearly. The free plan shows ads; Premium is ad-free.

Do I need an account, and what about privacy?
No account, no sign-up. Routine data is stored on our servers; usage analytics go through third-party tools. What you type is never used to train AI models. Email hello@routinery.app and we delete your data.

Does Routinery work offline?
Almost entirely. Routines, timers, voice, reminders and history run offline. Only device sync needs a connection.

What does Routinery connect to?
Siri Shortcuts, widgets, Apple Watch, and AI assistants over MCP. No direct sync with Apple Health or calendars. No export button either; pull your data out over MCP instead, free plan included.

What devices does Routinery run on?
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No web version.

Questions, bugs or ideas: hello@routinery.app

Routinery is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat ADHD.

results.description:
Forfeit is an app that adds accountability to your habits. We're based on the scientifically backed concept of Habit Contracts - popularised by Atomic Habits - that adding accountability to completing habits is massively effective.

Our 20k+ users have achieved a 94% success rate on over 75k forfeits.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set your forfeit
Set the task/habit that you want to complete, when you want to complete it by, and how you'll be held accountable if you don't complete it. This can be sending an accountability buddy a text or email!

2. Submit your evidence
Verify that you completed your habit using any of the methods defined below. This can be in the form of a photo, timelapse, self-verify, friend verify, GPS check-in, a web tracking limit, an Apple Health activity, a Strava run, a Whoop activity, a MyFitnessPal meal or anything else.

3. Or you fail
If you don't send evidence in time, your accountability method is triggered. This rarely happens - only 6% of forfeits fail. If you do fail, you can appeal the failed forfeit - we only want you to fail if it's a willpower issue, not if life gets in the way!


VERIFICATION METHODS
• Photo
Take a photo of the task that you completed, and an AI will verify if your photo matches your description.
Examples: At the gym, inbox zero, Duolingo completed, homework submitted, taking medication.

• Timelapse
Record a timelapse of you completing the tasks that you completed, and a human will verify if your timelapse matches your description.
Examples: Meditating, nighttime routine, stretching, working for 1hr.

• Self-Verify
Simply verify if you completed this task. No need for evidence!
Examples: No smoking, no drinking, no vaping, absolutely anything!

• Friend-Verify
Have an accountability buddy testify to whether you did or didn't complete a task.
Examples: No drinking, no phone in the house, no eating junk food.

• Apple Health
Set a threshold that you must cross in Apple Health (eg, 10,000 steps). Thousands of apps sync to this.
Examples: 10,000 steps, 20 mins meditation, 30 min bike ride, less than 2000 calories consumed.

• GPS Check-in
Set a GPS location that you must be within 100m of by the deadline.
Examples: Check into the gym, work on time, home by a certain time.

• Location Reminders
Get a reminder when you arrive at or leave a place you've saved, even when Forfeit is closed. Background location is optional.
Examples: "You're home - time to walk the dog", "At the gym - log your workout".

• GPS Avoid
Set a location that you won't be within a certain radius of at the deadline.
Examples: Not being at a bar on the weekends, leaving the house at a certain time.

• RescueTime integration
We sync with RescueTime, a web time-tracking app. You can use this to set thresholds on websites/desktop apps.
Examples: Max 30 mins on reddit.com, minimum 2hrs on VSCode, max 30 mins on gmail.com

• Pomodoro timer
This is a timer that if you click off, you fail.
Examples: Working for 30 mins, meditating for 20 mins, studying for 45 mins.



OTHER FEATURES
• X days/week: Set forfeits to be due a certain number of times per week (eg, work out 3x/week)
• Certain days/week: Set forfeits only to be due on certain days (eg, weekdays, or Mo/We/Fr)
• Appeal anything: If you have to skip a submission, simply send in an appeal, and it'll be reviewed in a few hours by a human.
• Varying leniency modes: Depending on your leniency mode (lenient, normal, hard), you may or may not be required to justify your appeal with evidence. Hard mode doesn't allow appeals.
• Screen Time integration: If you go over your limit, you're held accountable.

results.description:
Your apps open when the day's work is done. Not before.

Lockmode gives you the two things willpower does not: a list of what today is actually for, and a phone that stays shut until it is finished.

THE LOCK

Pick the apps, games and websites that take your day — one by one, or a whole category at once. They stay shut while anything on today's list is still due, and they open the moment you tick the last thing off.

There is no countdown to wait out and no timer to game. The only two ways past it are to finish, or to turn the lock off yourself — one tap, in plain sight.

It runs on Apple's Screen Time, so it holds when the app is closed, force-quit, or after a restart. Calls, messages and everything else keep working normally.

THREE MORE WAYS TO SHUT AN APP

Quick block: a saved set of apps, shut by a tap and opened by the same tap.
Daily limit: thirty minutes of social media a day. Spend them whenever you like; when they are gone, those apps stay shut until midnight.
Schedules: work hours, study blocks, mornings, nights. Set it once and it blocks and unblocks on its own, without you ever opening the app.

Run all four at once if you want. They never fight each other — an app stays shut while any one of them says it should be.

HABITS THAT ASK SOMETHING OF YOU

Choose which weekdays each habit is due, give it a number to hit — four litres, ten pages, two sessions — and a reminder at the hour you mean to do it.

CHALLENGES

When one habit at a time is not enough, take on a programme: 30, 75 or 90 days of a fixed standard. Its habits land on your list for the whole run, and a day only counts if you did every one of them — the run is a tally of days you earned, never a number that flatters you.

A STREAK YOU CANNOT FAKE

A day closes when everything due that day is done — your own habits and any challenge you are carrying. A day with nothing due is stepped over. Anything less than a finished day sets the streak back to zero.

SEE THE SHAPE OF YOUR LIFE

Every habit belongs to one of six pillars — Physical, Health, Mental, Social, Career and Discipline — and each is scored from what you have actually done, not what you intended. The chart shows the thin side of your life at a glance, and it is usually the one you have been avoiding. Below it, every day you have used the app, as a calendar you can scroll back through.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN

Seven widgets — your streak, today's list, the state of the lock, a single habit you keep losing, the whole run as a grid, your six pillars, and a line worth reading first thing. While the lock is up it also sits on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

There is no account to create and no server of ours holding your habits. The blocking runs on Apple's Screen Time, Device Activity and Managed Settings frameworks — which is why it holds when the app is closed, and also why we never learn which apps you chose. Apple hands the app sealed tokens, not names.

WHAT PEOPLE USE LOCKMODE FOR

Making the morning's real work the price of unlocking the phone.
Getting through a 75-day challenge without quietly dropping a day.
Studying and deep work that stay deep.
Building a routine that survives the third week.

Lockmode does not ask you to have more willpower. It makes the shortcut unavailable.

SwornIn is not a habit tracker.

It's a commitment app. You swear a promise with a deadline, choose the apps you're willing to lose if you break it, sign your name to it — and your phone enforces the consequence automatically, even if SwornIn is closed when the deadline passes.

How it works

1. Make a promise — once, daily, or every week.
2. Choose what you'll lose if you fail: the apps that get locked.
3. Sign the contract. Name, date, your own signature.
4. Keep it, or don't. There is no early unlock. Not by you, not by us.

The stakes get real

Break a promise once, and your chosen apps lock for 24 hours. Break a second, and it's 48. Break a third, and it isn't your apps that lock — it's SwornIn itself, until the wait runs out. Every lockout clears for free, always — there's no way to pay your way out. Break your word enough times and even that stops: after ten resets, the next lockout is permanent.

Your record — every promise you've broken — survives deleting your data from within the app. It's the one thing SwornIn remembers on purpose, right up until you actually delete the app.

Built for one thing

No social feed. No leaderboard. No accounts, no cloud, nothing about you leaves your phone. SwornIn does exactly one job: making sure your word to yourself actually costs something.

Go further with Premium

Free gets you one active promise at a time and 30 days of history. Premium (a one-time lifetime purchase) removes both caps, and adds Trusted Contacts — invite up to three people to be notified the moment you keep or break a promise, whether or not you ever open the app again.

Make fewer promises. Keep every one.

FAIR FIGHTS

results.description:
Keep a habit. Raise a creature.

Every habit you track lays an egg. Keep your promise and it hatches — then it grows, day by day, from a wobbly baby to a winged adult, and at last into its prime. Let it down, and it leaves. Keep your word three days in a row, and it comes home.

ONE CHECK-IN A DAY
Once a day, tell it how it went. Kept your promise? It eats and grows stronger. Slipped? Say so honestly: it mopes for a while, then carries on. Nothing grows it but the habit itself. Check in from the app, the Lock Screen, Control Center, your Apple Watch or Siri.

EXPLORE ITS WORLD
Every creature has a world to explore from above: the dragon's meadow, Zeus's Olympus, Hera's garden, Poseidon's sea. Keep your promise and it lights up, a glimmering trail leading to the day's best find. Each day brings a board of goals and a visitor. Find gems, food and quote stones; spend your gems on hats and keepsakes for the nest; and face the temptations that live there in turn-based battles that grow with your creature, every attack played out with its own sound. A boss waits in every world, and its trophy stands at the nest once it's beaten. The longer you keep your habit, the further it can go.

CHOOSE YOUR CREATURE
A dragon, or one of the Olympians: Zeus, Hera or Poseidon, each with powers and a home of their own. How you keep the habit shapes the adult it becomes: Gold, Dawn, Night or Comeback.

IT LIVES WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Your creature has a day of its own, whether the app is open or not. It sleeps at night; by day it trains, plays and naps in the sun. Open the app and it notices you; tap it and it beams. It even talks.

HOLD THE LINE
When a craving hits, tap "I'm tempted". Your creature squares up to it with you for ten calm minutes.

MEDITATE AND PLAY
Meditate with your creature, from 1 to 20 minutes, while the prime it could become lends it power, with calm music and a gentle voice, or a steady tone you choose by its frequency. Or play: Echo Stones, a memory game that grows harder with every round you pass, and Lookout, where you catch two things in one split-second glance and try to beat your best speed.

IT KEEPS A DIARY
Every day gets a page in its diary. On an iPhone with Apple Intelligence, the words come from Apple's on-device model, privately, and each sentence is checked against what really happened. Everywhere else it writes in words of its own.

LET IT DOWN, AND IT LEAVES A NOTE
Miss a day and it mopes. Two, and it packs its bag. Three bad days in a row and it leaves in the night, with a note. But it never dies: three good days in a row bring it home.

YOUR STORY, AND YOUR DATA
Your streak runs as a rail of pixels, with a flame that grows, and every milestone earns a badge for its wall. Its story shows every day as a pixel, your best and hardest days and how it grew, as a card or a video to share. Flip to Data for the numbers: kept rate with a 95% interval, streak survival, your check-in clock, momentum, a forecast, a pivot table, a day-by-day log, and CSV or JSON export.

FRIENDS, THROUGH MESSAGES

Scroll Toll helps you build healthier phone habits by turning screen time into workout time. When your screen time runs out, the app blocks access to those apps

**Not a fitness app. A discipline instrument.**

300 is built for people who have decided to stop negotiating with themselves. It's a brutally simple contract: every single day, you complete your chosen number of push-ups and squats. No skipping. No modifications. No excuses.

Choose your weight—from the INITIATE's 50 reps to the SPARTAN's 200, or the full **THE 300**: 300 push-ups and 300 squats daily. Lock yourself in for 30-day cycles. Watch the calendar fill with your decisions.

**What you get:**

- **The Pact:** Five difficulty tiers. Pick one. You're locked in for the full 30-day cycle.
- **The Ledger:** A visual timeline of every day you fulfilled or neglected your commitment. See your discipline (and failures) laid bare.
- **The Lock:** When you finish your reps, the app locks you out for 10 minutes. No distractions. No notifications. Sit in the silence you earned.
- **Memento Mori:** A meditation view showing your life as a percentage. How many days have you lived? How many remain? Let that inform today.
- **The Forge:** End-of-cycle verdicts. CRACKED. TEMPERED. FORGED. FORGED IN FIRE. PERFECT FORGE. Each streak is a badge earned through fire.
- **Home & Lock Screen Widgets:** Carry your daily commitment on every screen. The contribution grid. The mortality counter. No escape.
- **The Forge Wallpaper:** A full-year view of your discipline—365 dots, each one a decision you made.
- **Daily Stoic Quotes:** Each morning, a passage to anchor your practice.

**Built on Stoic principles.** 300 embraces memento mori—the practice of contemplating your mortality. You have a finite number of days. This app ensures you spend them consciously.

**No subscription. No account. No tracking.** This is between you and the work. Open the app offline. Log your reps. Leave.

**For the genuinely committed.** This isn't motivational. There's no celebration or virtual rewards. You get a simple calendar and the weight of your own choice. That's the design.

The 300 is inspired by the ancient Spartans and the philosophical traditions of Stoicism. It's for people building character in the forge of daily discipline.

_"The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way."_ — Marcus Aurelius

Habicat is a pixel-style RPG gamified habit tracker designed to help you fight procrastination with instant game-like feedback and build good habits with ease.

Here, every daily commitment turns into EXP and gems. Open chests, unlock achievements, strengthen your own character, and make your progress clearly visible.

Treat habit-building like a game where no princess needs saving. Every Boss you face comes from laziness and challenges in real life. There is no final ending, only a version of you that keeps growing across the open field of life.

----- Features -----

· Gamified Growth: A unique pixel art style. Complete real-life tasks through check-ins and grow your own character.

· Monthly Boss Challenge: A 30-day habit-building challenge. Step out of your comfort zone, embrace change, and defeat the little monsters in daily life.

· Habit Setup: Flexible habit settings let you add habits based on your needs, so you can see what needs to be done each day at a glance.

· Motivation System: Unlock a beautiful achievement wall, plus many hidden achievement surprises.

· Personalization and Widgets: Widgets support one-tap check-ins, data tracking, and cat supervision to help rescue procrastinators and ADHD minds.

· Privacy and Security: Native Apple privacy protection with iCloud account data backup.

From the Developer's Desk:
Life should be as delightful as playing a game, filled with enthusiasm and zest.

When I was fresh out of university, I dove into TED Talks, seeking life's purpose and fresh perspectives. A talk titled "Games Change the World" caught my eye. "Aren't games just for fun?" I pondered, clicking on the video. It was a discourse by the author of "Reality Is Broken." She emphasised how gamers, engrossed in virtual realms, feel genuine happiness from achievements there. So why do we struggle to find the same fulfilment in our real-world tasks?

This revelation made me think. Often, we abandon activities like running or reading because immediate gratification is missing. Our minds crave instant rewards. I designed this app to mirror the instant feedback of games, fuelling your journey towards achieving goals and cementing good habits.

If Sisyphus got upgrades and rewards every time he pushed his boulder, perhaps his task wouldn't seem so endless?

Forge is the Discipline OS.

A gamified self-improvement app where your Future Self gives you missions to conquer procrastination, build habits, and level up your life.

Daily Missions

XP & Streaks
Earn rewards, build streaks, and track your progress like a game.

Future Self Chat
Talk with your AI mentor who embodies the version of you that has already succeeded.
Requires Forge Pro subscription.

Squads
Team up with friends or allies to stay accountable and motivated.
May require Forge Pro subscription.

Rituals & Slayer
Face off against your vices like procrastination and laziness in ritual challenges.
May require Forge Pro subscription.

Demon Shield & Focus Lock
Block digital traps and protect your focus.
May require Forge Pro subscription.

Why Forge?
Most habit apps are boring checklists. Forge is a world you live in where discipline feels like a quest, not a chore.

Start forging your best self today.
